title: Prepare input structure
action: Construct the crystal structure input file for Cr2GeC using the lattice constants a=2.925 Å, c=12.024 Å, space group P63/mmc, and atomic positions according to the paper's description (two Cr, one Ge, one C per formula unit in the conventional cell).
description: Build the input structure needed for DFT calculations.

title: Total energy calculations for magnetic configurations
action: Perform self-consistent DFT calculations using GGA-PBE+U (U=1.95 eV, J=0.95 eV) for nonmagnetic (NM), ferromagnetic (FM), and ferrimagnetic (FIM) spin configurations. For FIM, set initial magnetic moments on Cr atoms to obtain the ferrimagnetic ordering: ferromagnetic coupling within the Cr-C-Cr trilayer and antiferromagnetic coupling across the Ge layer. Record the total energy for each configuration.
description: Total energies of NM, FM, and FIM configurations.

title: Site-resolved magnetic moment calculation
action: From the self-consistent charge density of the FIM configuration (step1), compute the spin magnetic moment inside each atomic sphere (using the DFT code's post-processing tool such as projwfc.x in QE). Sum the site-resolved moments to obtain the total net magnetic moment.
description: Site-resolved spin magnetic moments for the FIM state.

title: Total density of states (TDOS)
action: Using the self-consistent charge density of the FIM configuration (step1), compute the spin-resolved total density of states (e.g., via dos.x in QE). Output the energy grid and the corresponding spin-up and spin-down DOS.
description: Spin-polarized total density of states for the ferrimagnetic phase.
